name: bines-os
label: Bines OS
description: Boards, items, subitems, updates, files and AI agents of Bines OS: instant triggers that register their own webhooks, actions and searches with each board's columns.

watchItemsMovedToGroup.label: Bines OS: Items Moved to a Group

watchItemsMovedToAnyGroup.label: Bines OS: Items Moved to Any Group

watchItemsMovedToBoard.label: Bines OS: Items Moved to This Board

listValues.label: List the values of a column

watchItemsCreated.label: Watch Items Created
watchItemsCreated.description: An item was added to the board.

watchColumnValueChanged.label: Watch Column Value Changed
watchColumnValueChanged.description: A value of the chosen column changed.

watchStatusChanged.label: Watch Status Changed
watchStatusChanged.description: A status column changed — optionally only one column, or only to one label.

watchAnyColumnChanged.label: Watch Any Column Changed
watchAnyColumnChanged.description: Any value of the board changed.

watchItemsRenamed.label: Watch Items Renamed
watchItemsRenamed.description: An item got a new name.

watchUpdates.label: Watch Updates
watchUpdates.description: An update (comment) was posted on an item.

watchItemsMovedToGroup.label: Watch Items Moved to a Group
watchItemsMovedToGroup.description: An item moved into the chosen group.

watchItemsMovedToAnyGroup.label: Watch Items Moved to Any Group

watchItemsDeleted.label: Watch Deleted Items
watchItemsDeleted.description: An item was moved to the trash.

watchItemsRestored.label: Watch Restored Items
watchItemsRestored.description: An item came back from the trash or the archive.

watchItemsMovedToBoard.label: Watch Items Moved to This Board
watchItemsMovedToBoard.description: An item moved here from another board.

watchUpdatesEdited.label: Watch Edited Updates
watchUpdatesEdited.description: An update (comment) on an item was edited.

watchUpdatesDeleted.label: Watch Deleted Updates
watchUpdatesDeleted.description: An update (comment) on an item was deleted.

watchFilesAdded.label: Watch Files Added
watchFilesAdded.description: A file was added to a files column or an update.

watchGroupsCreated.label: Watch Groups Created
watchGroupsCreated.description: A group was added to the board.

watchColumnsCreated.label: Watch Columns Created
watchColumnsCreated.description: A column was added to the board.

watchSubitemsCreated.label: Watch Subitems Created
watchSubitemsCreated.description: A subitem was added under an item.

watchSubitemColumnChanged.label: Watch Subitem Column Changed
watchSubitemColumnChanged.description: A value of a subitem changed — optionally only one subitem column.

watchSubitemStatusChanged.label: Watch Subitem Status Changed
watchSubitemStatusChanged.description: A status column of a subitem changed — optionally only one column, or only to one label.

watchSubitemsRenamed.label: Watch Subitems Renamed
watchSubitemsRenamed.description: A subitem got a new name.

watchSubitemsDeleted.label: Watch Deleted Subitems
watchSubitemsDeleted.description: A subitem was moved to the trash.

watchSubitemUpdates.label: Watch Subitem Updates
watchSubitemUpdates.description: An update (comment) was posted on a subitem.

watchAutomationSends.label: Watch "Send to Integrations"
watchAutomationSends.description: A Bines OS automation ran its "send to integrations" action (any trigger, any conditions).

createItem.label: Create an Item
createItem.description: Creates an item with column values.

updateItem.label: Update an Item
updateItem.description: Changes an item’s name and column values. Empty fields leave the column unchanged.

getItem.label: Get an Item
getItem.description: Returns an item with its column values.

deleteItem.label: Delete an Item
deleteItem.description: Moves an item to the trash (restorable for 30 days).

duplicateItem.label: Duplicate an Item
duplicateItem.description: Duplicates an item, optionally with its updates.

moveItemToGroup.label: Move an Item to a Group
moveItemToGroup.description: Moves an item to another group of its board.

moveItemToBoard.label: Move an Item to a Board
moveItemToBoard.description: Moves an item to another board. Columns are matched by type and title (else the only column of that type), as the move dialog proposes.

createSubitem.label: Create a Subitem
createSubitem.description: Creates a subitem under an item, with the sub-board’s column values.

updateSubitem.label: Update a Subitem
updateSubitem.description: Changes a subitem’s name and column values.

moveSubitem.label: Move a Subitem
moveSubitem.description: Moves a subitem (with its own subitems) under another item or subitem of the same board.

deleteSubitem.label: Delete a Subitem
deleteSubitem.description: Moves a subitem to the trash (restorable for 30 days).

createUpdate.label: Create an Update
createUpdate.description: Posts an update (comment) on an item.

uploadFile.label: Upload a File
uploadFile.description: Uploads a file to a files column of an item.

createGroup.label: Create a Group
createGroup.description: Adds a group to a board.

applyItemTemplate.label: Create an Item From a Template
applyItemTemplate.description: A new item with its subitems from one of the board’s item templates — or the template’s subitems under an existing item. One undo for all of it.

moveSubitemUp.label: Move a Subitem Up a Level
moveSubitemUp.description: Moves a subitem under its grandparent; a first-level subitem becomes an item of the board.

tickUpdateTask.label: Tick a Check Box of an Update
tickUpdateTask.description: Ticks or clears one check box of an update or reply (counted from 1, in the text’s order).

addFileLink.label: Add a Link to a Files Column
addFileLink.description: Adds a web link to a files column of an item, beside its files.

startTimer.label: Start a Timer
startTimer.description: Starts the token owner’s timer on a timer column of an item.

stopTimer.label: Stop a Timer
stopTimer.description: Stops the token owner’s timer on a timer column of an item.

addTimeEntry.label: Log Time
addTimeEntry.description: Logs time by hand on a timer column (at most 24 hours, not in the future).

renameGroup.label: Rename a Group
renameGroup.description: Gives a group of a board a new title.

deleteGroup.label: Delete a Group
deleteGroup.description: Deletes a group of a board (its items go to the trash with it).

createColumn.label: Create a Column
createColumn.description: Adds a column to a board. A title the board already has gets the next free number. Types that need settings (formula, mirror, connected boards) are made with Make an API Call.

runAgent.label: Run an AI Agent
runAgent.description: Runs an AI agent now with a prompt. The token needs the agents:run scope.

getBoardSchema.label: Get a Board Schema
getBoardSchema.description: Returns a board’s groups and columns (type, options, value schema).

searchItems.label: Search Items
searchItems.description: Lists a board’s items matching free text and column filters (all pages).

findItems.label: Find Items by Column Value
findItems.description: Finds items by a column value: phone numbers match by digits, emails and text ignore case. Use the column "name" for the item name.

getSubitems.label: Get Subitems of an Item
getSubitems.description: Lists the subitems right under an item (or under a subitem), in their order.

searchSubitems.label: Search Subitems
searchSubitems.description: Lists the subitems of a board matching free text and subitem column filters (all pages).

findSubitems.label: Find Subitems by Column Value
findSubitems.description: Finds subitems by a value of a subitem column (phone by digits, emails and text ignore case).

listUsers.label: List Users
listUsers.description: Lists the active members of the account.

getTimeEntries.label: Get the Time Log of an Item
getTimeEntries.description: Lists an item’s time entries, newest first.

searchEverything.label: Search Everything
searchEverything.description: Items (name or values), boards, updates and people matching a text (2+ characters) that the token can see.

listTeams.label: List Teams
listTeams.description: Lists the account’s teams with their members.

listBoards.label: List Boards
listBoards.description: Lists the boards the token can open.

makeApiCall.label: Make an API Call
makeApiCall.description: Any Bines OS REST call with this connection (see /api/docs on your instance).
